prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / watercolor panorama continuity repair for the Lemoncello wedding invitation.
EDIT TARGET = reference 1, the existing wide background composition. Produce ONE high-resolution landscape image at approximately 3072 x 1776, preserving its 1320:763 aspect ratio and framing. It covers exactly three adjacent portrait phone viewports. This is an EDIT of the existing scene, not a redesign.
Reference 2 is the rightmost band of the original Hero, and reference 3 is the leftmost band of the destination cocktail scene: these establish the exact scale, colors, coastline, sky and terrace connection. Do not bake the Hero's foreground big lemon plant, drink or top hanging branch into your output; they are separate layers. Reference 4 (bottle and lemons) is the mandatory ORIGINAL PRIMARY watercolor technique/palette master. Reference 5 (approved house landscape) is mandatory integration style, not new subject matter.
TASK: eliminate the very obvious vertical join at x=33% and the discontinuity around x=67% of reference 1. Repaint the middle connecting landscape so the pale coast and Italian hillside town on the left become one believable continuous landscape leading to the cocktail terrace on the right. No vertical boundaries, mist curtains, blur bands, cutaway collage, duplicated horizons, doubled church towers, floating architecture, or step changes of scale. Let the distant mountain slope and same coastal village evolve naturally into the garden, cypresses and terrace. The cream stone balustrade must connect naturally to the original Hero's foreground railing visible in reference 2; its continuation starts at about x=33%, y=77%, then leads in perspective toward the terrace. Keep the stone rail and columns crisp and proportional, no jump in top-rail height at the join. The sea occupies the lower-left and stays the same soft blue; terrace paving expands gradually to the right.
PRESERVE INVARIANTS: Keep the first 25% of the target (quiet cream/sky-blue sky, coast, sea) and final 28% (right-side villa, green shutters, yellow/ivory striped scalloped parasols, drinks bar, tables, plants and cream/blue paving) almost exactly registered to the target. No recentering, no overall zoom, no resizing or relocating the right cocktail scene. Keep the large calm sky in the left third for separate live monogram and texts. Keep the left village church's original position about x=32%, y=43% and its lovely painterly details; blend it into a continuous hillside without the abrupt vertical sliced edge. Any work needed to blend overlaps must remain locally confined to the central connection. Do not add people, birds, signs, boards, texts, letters, monograms or UI. No foreground hanging branches: they are animated as separate layers. Keep ample lower-right paving empty for the existing overlay sign.
STYLE: traditional soft luminous watercolor, translucent pigment washes, visible paper grain inside the paint, loose brushwork with legible architectural/botanical detail. Diluted sky/pastel blue, butter yellow, warm ivory, desaturated olive/sage, restrained navy. Preserve the detailed scene rather than blurring it. Moderate contrast, no thick dark outlines, no oversaturated orange or purple, no oil, photo, vector/cartoon, glossy 3D or sticker look. Fill every outer edge fully with painted scene, no white frame or alpha edge fade. One coherent full-bleed painting.
